question: A studio feature has a 110-page script. Roughly how many shooting days will it need?
move: Break a schedule into the unit the planners themselves count in.
trap: Guessing a week or two, forgetting each minute needs many setups.
hint: Start from how many script pages a crew gets through in a day.
steps: A script page runs about one minute on screen.
A studio unit typically shoots 2 to 3 pages a day; take 2.5.
reference: Singleton, Film Scheduling: Or, How Long Will It Take to Shoot Your Movie?, 2nd edn, Lone Eagle, 1991
